author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a domed head with rounded floppy ears folded at the sides, a round nose, mouth and jowls, and neck lines below; reads as a dog face like the dalmatian reference. The rejected drawing was an open arch with stub ears and a blob nose.
omissions: The tiny dot eyes are dropped (no room 8 from the ears, the nose and each other); the dalmatian spots are not in the reference outline and are not added.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L symmetric about x 24: dome between nodes (11,13)/(37,13) over (24,8); ear beziers out to x 4/44 and round to tips (9,29), folding to (13,26); face sides from nodes to the folds, cheeks to jowl corners (17,34); necks to (14,40)/(34,40); nose ring r2 at (24,24), mouth to (24,31), jowls to the corners.
